name: ModelVariant757_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant757_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the light dims while sparks spray from a model part and shards fly to a jittered point near the opposing slot, each bursting into sixteen tinted fragments, before the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x14-byte command row indexed by the request, seeds the shards, fragments and sparks and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the row's start, 4 once the first shard has burst, 1 once when the last has burst after spawning ends and 2 when the light is back; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-774 and 871 images build it through french_model_variant/variant774_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH (PAL CLUT row 0x3D28) at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
